title: Electoral Politics
subtitle: Understanding the Democratic Process of Elections
subject: Social Science
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand why elections are necessary in a democracy
Analyze the process of elections in India
Evaluate what makes elections in India democratic
Understand the role of the Election Commission

ai_context.learning_goal: The student should deeply understand the mechanics, necessity, and democratic integrity of the electoral process in India, integrating ancient democratic concepts.
common_misconceptions: Elections and democracy are the exact same thing
The ruling party controls the Election Commission
One person's vote doesn't really matter
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles, ask them how decisions are made in their own classroom or family, and scale that up to a country.
